description: This file contains a PHP class for managing return status in the OpenCart admin localization module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting return statuses, along with handling HTTP requests and responses, rendering views, and managing breadcrumbs and pagination.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing return statuses within the localisation module in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the return status list view with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of return statuses, with sorting, pagination, and fetching data from the model.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Prepares the data for listing return statuses, including sorting, ordering, pagination, and rendering the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Displays the list of return statuses as a JSON response based on filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return status, pre-filled if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the form submission to add or update a return status, responds with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return statuses based on the posted data, responds with JSON.
